commands.command:
set -eu
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a4b1f629c1286d631ac208515b71aeeaa7c44b23" ]
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
LOG=/tmp/c6-smoke.log
[ -s "$LOG" ]
grep -q 'measurement local_i2c/' "$LOG"
grep -q 'measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9/' "$LOG"
grep -q 'link backend=uart1' "$LOG"
grep -q 'drop=0 short=0' "$LOG"
if grep -Eiq 'Guru Meditation|abort\(\)|panic|watchdog|ZIGBEE_DEVICE_LEAVE_RESET|APS.*security.*failed|security.*failed|dropped [1-9][0-9]* gateway events|dropped [1-9][0-9]* GatewayLink messages' "$LOG"; then
  echo 'fatal smoke-test pattern found'
  exit 1
fi
echo 'C6 UART smoke PASS: SCD4x + SONOFF + link telemetry healthy'
commands.output: C6 UART smoke PASS: SCD4x + SONOFF + link telemetry healthy
